usage: The word '大堂' refers to the lobby or entrance hall of a building.
It is commonly used to describe the main reception area in residential or office buildings.
You can use '大堂' as a noun in sentences to indicate the location where people meet or wait.
'大堂' often appears in phrases related to directions or facilities inside a building.
It can also refer to a public or semi-public space near the entrance used for socializing or resting.
